title: tailscale serve command
snippet: Jan 26, 2026 · If you use the tailscale serve command with the -bg flag, it runs persistently in the background until you disable it. When you reboot the device or restart Tailscale from the command line using tailscale down and tailscale up, Serve automatically resumes sharing.
